checks: The real panel renders SQL quality aggregates, sample sizes and transparent policy.
One participant confirmation persists but does not complete an unverified session.
The second participant confirms through real HTTP and the PostgreSQL RPC, unlocking the review.
A real low-score review updates PostgreSQL, deactivates recent quality and preserves the completed session.
A reputation fetch error offers retry without pretending there are no reviews.
Reputation fits 320/390/768/1440px in light, dark and Calm themes.
scope: Real React, HTTP client, Express and PostgreSQL-in-memory with synthetic accounts. No real user data, Supabase writes or Gemini calls.
